note: SHA-256 fingerprints (of the DER certificate) for the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs disclosed in October 2026. Source: Cisco Talos advisory (https://blog.talosintelligence.com/compromised-intermediate-certificates/); the EM DV TLS CA - G3B hash also matches the published OpenJDK blocked.certs list. These are the emSign/eMudhra-issued intermediates. Their Sectigo/Comodo AAA cross-signs have distinct fingerprints that are not listed here, but they share the same weak keys, so Keyhole's weak-key detector flags those too. Confirm against CCADB / Mozilla OneCRL before relying on this in production.
